summary: Patria v0.5 backend refactor + four correctness fixes fully verified. 119/119 local pytest suites PASS (including the new test_patria_v5_correctness.py with 15 tests covering council idempotency, relativedelta-based rhythm/Sacred-Heart math, and the 1962 Sundays-after-Epiphany resumption rubric). Added a new public-URL smoke suite (test_patria_v5_public_endpoints.py, 24 tests) that hits the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: all 19 router prefixes reachable (200) after the server.py split into /app/backend/routers/, council finalize end-to-end idempotent (2 created → 0 on re-finalize already=true → only +1 when a new title is added; tasks materialize with category='council' and source_meeting_id and appear in /api/tasks), rhythm monthly observe → next_due = today + 1 calendar month via dateutil.relativedelta, sacred-heart enthroned on Feb 29 returns a valid next_renewal (Feb 28/29 clamp), and Traditional 1962 liturgical labels match brief: Jan 18 2026 → 'II Sunday after Epiphany', Oct 25 2026 → 'XXII Sunday after Pentecost', Nov 1/8/15 2026 → IV/V/VI Sunday after Epiphany (resumed) (Nov 1 surfaced via season_label because All Saints overrides name), Nov 22 2026 → 'Last Sunday after Pentecost'. Demo seed unaffected, demo session still authenticates. Total: 143/143 backend tests green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now a clean ~60-line entry point. Router boundaries are clear and dependency injection via /app/backend/deps.py is well-isolated. No code-review concerns this round.
_next_due() and _next_anniversary() now correctly use dateutil.relativedelta and dateutil cleanly handles Feb 29 / end-of-month clamps. Earlier review items (3, 4, 5 from iteration_5) are resolved.

Council finalize_meeting now diffs by (assignment_id OR title) against existing meeting-scoped tasks before insert — the {ok, already, tasks_created, tasks_existing} shape is consistent and idempotent under both repeat-finalize and aid-stripping client behaviour. Earlier review item (3) resolved.

1962 'Sundays after Epiphany' rubric in liturgical.py correctly resumes displaced Sundays after XXIII (or last available) Sunday after Pentecost, immediately before the Last Sunday. The first_sunday_of_advent fix (was returning Saturdays in some years) is the prerequisite and is also covered by an assertion across 2020–2030.

Minor: no auth-required tests on the public-URL suite use the demo session — they seed a throwaway session and tear it down, which is the correct hygiene per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No demo data was mutated.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_patria_v5_public_endpoints.py (new — 24 public-URL smoke/E2E tests for the v0.5 refactor and four correctness fixes)
test_credentials: Demo: SESSION_TOKEN=demo_session_patria, USER_ID=demo-user-patria, HOUSEHOLD_ID=hh_demo_patria. Used only for read-only smoke (/api/, /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard, /api/liturgical/today). Mutating tests seed throwaway test-user-pub-{ts} sessions and households (cleaned up in fixture teardown).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Pytest fixtures create ephemeral users/households/sessions and tear them all down (users, user_sessions, households, tasks, meetings, rhythms, sacred_heart collections). Demo data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v0.5 refactor verified clean. Backend layout: server.py (~60 lines) + /app/backend/deps.py (User/Household models, get_current_user, get_household, db, client) + /app/backend/routers/{auth,household,liturgical,rules,prayer,challenges,budget,schedule,tasks,goals,dashboard,council,sacred_heart,rhythms}.py. Council finalize response shape is now {ok, already, tasks_created, tasks_existing} — earlier shape was {tasks_created} only; any downstream tests should be updated. Rhythm cadences supported: daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly via dateutil.relativedelta; unknown cadence falls back to weekly. Sacred Heart state shape: {enthroned_at, last_renewed_at, next_renewal, is_enthroned}. Traditional 1962 liturgical: when a fixed feast (e.g. All Saints) overrides the Sunday name, the resumed-Epiphany label moves into season_label — tests must check both fields. The first_sunday_of_advent bug fix is upstream of the entire 1962 rubric, so any future Advent-related tests can rely on Advent 1 being a Sunday.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced this iteration. Two initial public-URL test failures were my own payload errors (rhythm field is 'name' not 'title'; sacred-heart enthrone uses 'enthroned_at' not 'date'; observe endpoint returns {ok:true} with no body echo). Fixed in test code, not application code. After fixes, 143/143 green.
